decision.observation: 14 mph, gear 1, all dots pale. The car is centred on a wide gravel lane; the road sweeps right up-frame and then opens into a long straight along the top, with birches and a boulder on the left and pines on the right.
decision.hypothesis: The lane stays wide through the right-hand sweep and the car is well centred, so plain throttle should build speed without needing steer at 14 mph.
decision.memory: This lake-side right sweep is wide and forgiving: 10 to 14 mph on one plain W with no drift. The long straight beyond it is the next natural plain-W section.
